data.exact_reserve_text: Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 were reduced by GBP 57.6m in calendar year 2016. Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 were reduced by GBP 32.4m in calendar year 2015.

named_events.loss_description: The 2016 year was impacted by the Alberta wildfire natural catastrophe with losses of GBP 12.0m
The 2016 year was impacted by Hurricane Matthew with losses of GBP 5.9m

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding (closing 2015 balance) was GBP 737.922m. During calendar 2016 there was a reported net release in prior year reserves of GBP 57.6m driven by more favourable claims development and effective claims handling. The year also saw the acceptance of a RITC from Syndicate 1400 which materially increased gross and net reserves on the balance sheet; RITC and foreign exchange movements distort simple development comparisons. Named 2016 catastrophe impacts included the Alberta wildfire (GBP 12.0m) and Hurricane Matthew (GBP 5.9m).
raw_causal_phrases: Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 were reduced by GBP 57.6m in calendar year 2016.
The result included a release from prior year reserves of GBP 57.6m (2015, GBP 32.4m release).
This release is a result of more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.

Following the acceptance of Syndicate 1400's RITC from 1 January 2016, there has been an increase in the Statement of Financial Position for financial investments and cash, gross and net claims outstanding and reinsurers' share of claims outstanding.
The Syndicate has material exposure to motor casualty claims through motor treaty policies written on the 2014 and prior years of account.
In lieu of the announcement by the Lord Chancellor the Directors' best estimate view of the discount rate is 1.0%.

the held funds at the Syndicate can withstand deterioration from a change in discount rate to at least 0.0%, which is projected to have an adverse impact of GBP 26.7m on the current best estimate of a 1.0% discount rate.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year reserve movement (GROSS) was not explicitly stated in the notes. The report explicitly states a NET release of GBP 57.6m; gross movement by insurance liabilities column is not provided separately. The syndicate accepted a RITC from Syndicate 1400 on 1 Jan 2016 which materially increases gross reserves and distorts claims-development comparisons and the claims triangle; this limits reliable extraction of gross PYD from the triangle. The claims development triangle is present but RITC and OCR formatting issues prevented reliable gross diagonal extraction, so the prior year movement here uses the explicitly stated NET release and is flagged accordingly.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the report (page 35) but RITC accepted from Syndicate 1400 and OCR/formatting issues prevent reliable extraction of the full development matrix. Development rows omitted here for data quality reasons.
